title: 第十一章 炎刹之变第十二章 前往血炼
lines: 雷涅行走在万兽岭的山林间，入眼尽是苍翠碧绿之色。
但并非印象中，能给人带来自然恬静的清风乔林。
相反，当此林间有微风浮起时，让人有一股森冷凉意从心底反涌上脑，感到晃晃不可中日。
紧接着茂密过盛的林叶在这种风的带抚下，会以一种极为无序的方式上下起伏，点滴隐射着，经过层层筛减，透下来的稀疏光斑。
就是这般情形下，整个林内的场景在白天的时间中，能被光线反射出八九分的模样，但却会在恍惚间，透露出一抹诡异的暗淡。
要是有凡人行于此种诡异之地，恐怕其早就因为承受不住，这种环境带来的无形压力，逃下山去了。
但现在穿行在山林中的，可是雷涅这种修士，莫要说此山林只不过是能给人带来几分诡异之感而已，就算其中真的有什么妖兽埋伏藏匿，凭雷涅的神通威能，难道还会阴沟里翻船不成。
现在雷涅的心里，不仅没有丝毫戒备之意，相反，脑内还不断的闪现出诸多琐事，一副心不在焉的样子。
“那炎刹竟然离开了覆天宗，不知去向了！当真是果断啊！”
雷涅心里暗道。
显然现在雷涅心中所想之事，竟然与前不久，跟自己颇打过一翻交道的炎刹有关。
而雷涅之所以会想到，那与自己只是有过几面之缘的炎刹。
其中缘由，便是先前他在议事大殿报名时，听旁边的一名低阶弟子在与其同伴闲扯时，偶然提了一嘴，炎刹的名字，以及其在低阶弟子的圈子中，所造成的一翻不大不小的轰动。
在那低阶弟子的口述中，是两名弟子在执行门内任务时，经过太源谷东面的一处僻静山涧中，其二人一开始本是对这了无人烟的去处没做过多理会，一直往目的地飞遁前行。
怎料一股强悍的能量波动突然从远处山涧中爆发而开，止住了两人飞遁的趋势。
二者在好奇心的驱使下，调转了方向往能量爆发之地遁去，然而尚还没等他们到达波动爆发之地，只行进了大约一半的路程时，一道流光自先前爆发能量波动的方向闪现而出，并且在两名弟子为此惊骇的目光中越发夺目耀眼起来。
看到流光有着往自身方向袭来的架势，两名弟子都是不敢有丝毫怠慢，各自连忙取出灵器护体，以防奔袭过来的修士心中有什么歹意，在自己没有防备的情况下被其袭杀！
可就在流光的光芒在二人眼中越来越刺眼，那种恐怖波动的临近让二者险些顶不住压力，欲遁走逃离时。
那股流光却自行的，在尚还距二者有几百丈远时，瞬间顿住，悬空凝定下来！
望着此间一幕，二人皆是不敢上前打量流光中到底隐匿着何物，就这样僵持了许久，其中一名弟子终是放下心中顾虑，打算飞遁至流光周遭，查看一翻。
可也就是其刚刚有所举动，流光的光芒却是突的暗淡下来，显露出其中人影！
一名身穿麻袍，脸庞青秀的年轻男子与两名弟子遥遥对望。
双方在观得对方后，都是一阵愣神愕然，特别是那麻袍男子，脸上除了愕然外，还涌现出一股大事不妙的神情，随即其身形一阵模糊，就这么的，在两名弟子眼皮底下消失不见。
当两名弟子回过神来后，其人早就不知道跑到哪去了，更别说将之追赶拦住，查明这场古怪事情的真相。
两名弟子带着满肚子的疑惑，在完成任务返回宗内后，便向上面通报了此事的始末，以及事件中主角的相貌特征，而在他们最终得知捣鼓出此事的始作俑者，竟只是一名刚加入宗门，名叫炎刹的外门弟子时，两人皆是有些大眼瞪小眼起来。
一名凡化境小成的外门弟子，怎会发出那种连自己这两位凡化境大成的修士，都感到心惊的恐怖波动！
难不成其身上有什么重宝不成？！
content_en:
Reine was walking among the mountains and forests of Ten Thousand Beast Ridge, and all he could see was the green color.
But it is not the Qiaolin that brings natural tranquility to people in the impression.
On the contrary, when a breeze rises in the forest, a chilly feeling surges from the bottom of the heart to the head, making one feel swaying.
Immediately afterwards, under the caress of this wind, the overly dense forest leaves will rise and fall in an extremely disorderly manner, with bits and pieces of faint light shining through the layers of filters.
Under such circumstances, the entire scene in the forest can be reflected eight or nine times by the light during the day, but it will reveal a strange dimness in a trance.
If there were any mortals walking in such a strange place, they would probably have fled down the mountain long ago because they could not bear the invisible pressure brought by this environment.
But now, monks like Reine are walking through the mountains and forests. Don't say that this mountain forest can only give people a bit of a strange feeling. Even if there are some monsters hiding in it, with Reine's magical power, it will capsize in the ditch.
Now, Rene's heart not only showed no signs of alertness, but on the contrary, many trivial matters kept flashing through his mind, looking absent-minded.
"That Yansha actually left Futian Sect and disappeared without a trace! How decisive!"
Rene thought to himself.
Obviously, what Reine is thinking about now is actually related to Yansha, whom he had quite a deal with not long ago.
The reason why Reine thought about Yan Sha was that he had only met him a few times.
The reason was that when he was registering in the meeting hall, he heard a low-level disciple next to him accidentally mention Yan Cha's name while chatting with his companions, and it caused a small sensation in the circle of low-level disciples.
According to the oral account of the low-level disciple, two disciples passed by a secluded mountain stream east of Taiyuan Valley while performing tasks within the sect. The two of them did not pay much attention to this uninhabited place at first, and kept flying towards their destination.
Unexpectedly, a powerful wave of energy suddenly erupted from the mountain stream in the distance, stopping the two men from escaping.
Driven by curiosity, the two turned around and fled to the place where the energy broke out. However, before they could reach the place where the energy wave broke out, and they had only traveled about half of the way, a stream of light flashed out from the direction where the energy wave had previously erupted, and it became more and more dazzling in the horrified eyes of the two disciples.
Seeing that Liuguang was heading towards them, the two disciples did not dare to show any signs of neglect. They each quickly took out their spiritual weapons to protect their bodies, in case the monk who came over had any malicious intentions and would be attacked and killed without their own defenses!
But just as the light of the streamer became more and more dazzling in their eyes, the approach of that terrifying wave made them almost unable to withstand the pressure and wanted to run away.
The stream of light moved on its own. When Shang was still several hundred feet away from the two, it paused for an instant and settled in the air!
Looking at the scene here, both of them did not dare to step forward to see what was hidden in the flowing light. They remained in a stalemate for a long time. One of the disciples finally put aside his worries and planned to fly to the surroundings of the flowing light to take a look.
But just as he made a move, the light of the streamer suddenly dimmed, revealing the figure inside!
A young man wearing linen robes with a green face looked at two disciples from a distance.
After both parties saw each other, they were stunned for a while, especially the linen-robed man. In addition to being stunned, there was also a look of something bad happening on his face. Then his figure blurred for a while, and just like that, he disappeared under the eyes of the two disciples.
When the two disciples came to their senses, they had no idea where they had gone, let alone chasing and stopping them to find out the truth of this strange incident.
The two disciples were full of doubts. After completing the mission and returning to the sect, they reported the whole incident to the superiors, as well as the appearance and characteristics of the protagonist in the incident. When they finally learned that the initiator of the incident was actually an outer disciple named Yansha who had just joined the sect, both of them were a little bit wide-eyed.
How could an outer sect disciple with a small degree of attainment in the Mortal Transformation Realm emit such terrifying fluctuations that even frightened the two monks who had attained the Mortal Transformation Realm?
Could it be that he has some valuable treasure on his body? !
